## How to sign

Signing is electronic and happens once per contributor. When you open your first
pull request, CLA Assistant posts a comment asking you to sign; reply with the
exact sentence CLA Assistant quotes in its comment. Your signature is recorded
on the `cla-signatures` branch of this repository and covers all your future
Contributions to the Project.
